tagline: North America's largest residential cabinet manufacturer with premium quality and innovative design
hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric reflecting operational efficiency and profitability, with a significant decline in 2025 (4.4% vs 8.7% in 2024) signaling cost pressures and acquisition integration challenges

kpis.name: Net Revenue (consolidated sales)
kpis.description: Slight revenue increase of 1.3% in 2025 compared to 2024

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin declined to 30.3% in 2025 vs 32.5% in 2024, reflecting cost pressures from raw materials and labor

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin significantly reduced to 4.4% in 2025 vs 8.7% in 2024, due to higher SG&A expenses, depreciation, and restructuring charges related to acquisitions and the merger with American Woodmark

kpis.name: Net Income (profit)
kpis.description: Net income sharply declined to $26.7M in 2025 vs $125.9M in 2024, reflecting operational pressures and integration expenses

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS sharply declined to $0.21 in 2025 vs $0.96 in 2024

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.description: SG&A ratio increased to 24.4% in 2025 vs 22.3% in 2024, reflecting integration and pending merger-related expenses

kpis.name: Restructuring and Integration Charges
kpis.description: Restructuring charges of $15.2M in 2025 related to the acquisition of Supreme Cabinetry and the merger with American Woodmark

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks from cyberattacks and data breaches that could impact operations and reputation. The company has implemented a robust cybersecurity program with a dedicated VP and specialized team (Item 1A, p. 25)

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: MasterBrand operates in a competitive residential kitchen market that could affect sales and market share. The merger with American Woodmark is partly aimed at consolidating this position (Item 7, p. 29)

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Policies
risks.description: 10% tariffs on wood products directly impact cabinets and cabinetry
risks.score_rationale: MasterBrand is exposed to tariffs on wood, lumber, and wood-derived products (Section 232 tariffs at 10%, effective October 14, 2025). The company continues to monitor uncertain trade and tariff policies

risks.title: Housing Market Conditions
risks.score_rationale: MasterBrand depends on housing market conditions in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico for renovation and new construction (Item 7, MD&A)

risks.title: Acquisition Integration and Pending Merger
risks.score_rationale: MasterBrand is integrating the acquisition of Supreme Cabinetry (July 2024) and preparing for the merger with American Woodmark (expected closing early 2026). Risks include unrealized synergies, operational disruptions, and management distraction

risks.title: Raw Material Costs and Supply Chain
risks.score_rationale: MasterBrand relies heavily on third parties for raw material supply, making it vulnerable to cost fluctuations (Item 7, MD&A). Gross margin declined from 32.5% to 30.3% between 2024 and 2025

risks.title: Regulatory and Tax Compliance
risks.score_rationale: MasterBrand is subject to evolving tax, environmental, and other regulations. Compliance costs could increase with regulatory changes (Item 7, p. 29)

ai_positioning.summary: MasterBrand has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided 10-K. The technology strategy references using technology and data to enhance customer experience (visualization, ordering, delivery, and installation), but without specific details on AI or ML.
